entry_state: Chapter 7 encodes contextual values, shared alternatives, restricted posting, versioned modules and typed failures. New evidence, revised views and posterior updates remain separate; migrations cannot conceal changed recognition meaning. The next chapter must put these declarations into reconstruction and execution procedures while preserving unresolved inputs and distinct failure outcomes.
exit_state: Reconstruction begins with immutable filings and reviewed readings, retains residuals and joint symbolic families, and labels scoped search limits. A run supplies explicit conditional assumptions and information permissions. Event scheduling and atomic commit now preserve economic state, posting and replay identity; the detailed separation of assessment, posting permission and economic delta is still being developed.
findings: The ingestion procedure separates improved extraction versions, proposed readings and admitted corrections. A debt residual is not automatically classified as borrowing or repayment.
The six-step construction retains shared domains and unresolved families. Duplicate encodings cannot increase history mass or search coverage.
Conditional maturity assumptions remain displayed assumptions; perfect foresight is a separate policy and stream keys preserve paired randomness without equating every branch's events.
Event order is semantic when it affects results. The execution pseudocode validates bindings before replay lookup and changes economic and accounting state atomically. No additional defect confirmed.
